verdict.rationale: Exa is built around natural-language input. Search takes plain-language queries and returns page content (exa-docs-22), and Websets start from a natural-language query that the product then searches, verifies and enriches (exa-docs-28, exa-docs-8). The official MCP server lets assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor drive Exa's search, Agent and Connect tools conversationally (exa-docs-30, exa-docs-14), and community users confirm entering plain-language Websets queries hands-on (exa-comm-2). missing for 10: reliable hands-on results from natural-language Websets requests (users report missing enrichment columns and searches stuck on verification, exa-comm-2, exa-comm-3), and evidence that natural language covers operations beyond search and research, such as account or webset management.
